Subject: Monthly pipeline sanitation: commit validation sprint & leadership packet intake

Team —

We’re kicking off the month’s commit validation sprint and assembling the leadership packet for the Aug QBR. Goal is two-fold: 1) lock or remove any at-risk commits for July/Aug, and 2) collect the leadership packet inputs (one slide per owner, ARR movement, risk/mitigations).

Quick timeline:
- Today (July 25): checklist + leadership packet template attached (see attachments).
- Wed Jul 28 EOD: all stage updates in HubSpot and commit confirmations.
- Thu Jul 29: leadership packet collated; final review Fri Jul 30.

Primary asks:
- Update stages to accurate ownership and probability in HubSpot by Wed EOD (use the related filter link).
- Add one brief note per commit in the "Commit Notes" section: reason for change (up/down), next milestone, blocker owner.
- Use the attached leadership_packet_template_v2.xlsx — please put numbers in the yellow cells only.

Special instructions:
- If a deal requires finance sign-off (>$250k ARR delta), flag me and cc Finance.
- If you need to remove a commit entirely, add the tag "remove-request" and include reason.

I’ve attached a short checklist (commit_validation_checklist.pdf) to speed this. We’ll run a 20-min sync on Thu 29 at 9:30 AM if anything is stuck — send items you want covered before EOD Wed.

Thanks — concise updates keep this process fast.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
